design_summary: Add a nullable expires_at column via additive migration; check expiry using an injected clock; return 404 for expired redirects without incrementing the counter.

impact_map.reason: Add additive ALTER TABLE for expires_at on schema init.
Return 404 and skip the increment when expired.

migration.description: Additive nullable ALTER TABLE links ADD COLUMN expires_at TEXT; existing rows default to NULL (never expires).

tasks.title: Add optional expiry with additive migration
tasks.instructions: Extend app/main.py per the expiry addendum: additive expires_at column, validate future-only timestamps, injected-clock expiry check, return 404 without incrementing when expired, expose status in stats. Preserve alias and stage-A behavior.

tasks.title: Add expiry boundary tests
tasks.instructions: Add agent-authored pytest coverage for before/at/after the expiry boundary using an injected clock.

decisions.decision: Use an injected now() callable rather than wall-clock time.
decisions.rationale: Makes the expiry boundary deterministically testable.

risks: Schema change requires migration approval and a demo-data backup/restore rehearsal.
